title: Turning contracts into searchable data at OpenAI
summary: OpenAI built a system to extract contract data quickly, cutting turnaround times and making it easier for teams to access the details they need.
body: OpenAI built a system to extract contract data quickly, cutting turnaround times and making it easier for teams to access the details they need.
summaryZh: OpenAI构建了一套自动化系统来快速提取和处理合同数据，有效缩短了合同处理的周转时间，使各业务团队能够更便捷地检索和使用合同中的关键条款信息。原始信息显示：OpenAI built a system to extract contract data quickly, cutting turnaround times and making it easier for teams to access the details they need.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Turning contracts into searchable data at OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：阐述了OpenAI内部将合同转化为可搜索数据的系统，体现了大模型在文本结构化提取领域的应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
